findings.title: Unclear scope of site establishment
findings.message: The short and long text "Baustelle vollständig einrichten und vorhalten" does not specify which facilities, equipment, duration of provision or standards to be applied, violating VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 (eindeutig, erschöpfend). This creates a risk of later disputes on the extent of the service.
findings.suggestion: Detail the required facilities (e.g., Bauzaun, Lager, Stromanschluss), quantities, duration and any applicable standards (e.g., DIN 18299).

findings.title: Potential risk transfer to contractor
findings.message: The pauschal price without clear performance description may shift the risk of additional equipment or extended stand‑by time to the bidder, which can be deemed an unlawful risk allocation under § 307 BGB.
findings.suggestion: Introduce a clear performance description and separate allowances for optional extensions.

findings.title: Missing technical specifications for frost protection layer
findings.message: The description lacks material type, required thickness, thermal conductivity and any class (e.g., frost‑resistance class) required by the STLB‑Bau standard.
findings.suggestion: Specify material (e.g., granular frost protection, EPS), thickness (e.g., 150 mm), thermal conductivity and compliance with DIN 4108‑3.

findings.title: Insufficient data for PE‑HD pipe delivery
findings.message: Only diameter (DN 150) is given; missing pressure class, SDR, material grade, and reference norm (e.g., DIN 8077).
findings.suggestion: Add pressure rating (PN 10), SDR value, material grade (PE‑HD‑S‑B), and cite DIN 8077.

findings.title: Missing technical details for shaft construction
findings.message: No concrete class, reinforcement details, dimensions of the shaft, or reference to a standard (e.g., DIN 1045‑1) are provided.
findings.suggestion: State concrete strength (C25/30), reinforcement layout, shaft dimensions, and compliance with DIN 1045‑1.

findings.title: Missing specifications for masonry work
findings.message: The text only mentions "Kalksandsteinmauerwerk nach statischer Vorgabe" without indicating mortar type, bond pattern, or reference norm (e.g., DIN 1053).
findings.suggestion: Add mortar class (e.g., M 7,5), bond pattern, and reference to DIN 1053.

findings.title: Insufficient data for interior plaster
findings.message: Missing plaster type, thickness, and applicable norm (e.g., DIN 18550).
findings.suggestion: Specify plaster material (e.g., Gipsputz C 2), nominal thickness (e.g., 12 mm), and compliance with DIN 18550.

findings.title: Missing technical data for cement screed
findings.message: No screed thickness, drying time, reinforcement or reference to DIN 18550‑2 is given.
findings.suggestion: Add nominal thickness (e.g., 45 mm), reinforcement mesh, and curing conditions per DIN 18550‑2.

findings.title: Lack of details for paving slab work
findings.message: The description does not state stone type, size, joint width, or reference standard (e.g., DIN 18365).
findings.suggestion: Specify paving material (e.g., Betonstein 100 mm), joint width (e.g., 3 mm), and compliance with DIN 18365.

findings.title: Missing specifications for asphalt base layer
findings.message: No gradation, binder content, or minimum thickness is defined, which are required by the STLB‑Bau standard for asphalt layers.
findings.suggestion: Add required gradation (e.g., AC‑16), binder content (e.g., 5 % bitumen), and minimum thickness (e.g., 120 mm).

findings.title: Missing specifications for asphalt wearing course
findings.message: The text lacks details on stone size, binder content, surface texture and reference to a standard (e.g., DIN 18365‑2).
findings.suggestion: Specify stone size (e.g., 8 mm), binder content (e.g., 4 % bitumen), surface texture, and compliance with DIN 18365‑2.
